summary: Kong API Gateway 3.16, released September 22, adds OpenMeter-powered entitlement enforcement that can block requests when prepaid credits, usage limits, or plan entitlements are exhausted, plus runtime log-level tuning and per-principal plugin configuration. This strengthens Kong's usage-based monetization and enterprise-operations story, but it extends previously recorded OpenMeter evidence and includes no adoption, pricing, bookings, ARR, retention, or margin disclosure; the thesis remains 69/100 and model inputs are unchanged. No new IPO filing, financing, verified secondary transaction, acquisition, executive change, or company financial disclosure surfaced.
